breaking_news.headline: Meta plans to release AI-powered prediction market app, documents show
breaking_news.summary: The company is building an app separate from Facebook and Instagram where people can wager on the outcome of real-world events, using "play money."

breaking_news.headline: World Cup fans are missing games after their resale tickets fall through
breaking_news.summary: The ordeal has left fans forced to either miss out on a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity or scramble to find new tickets, often costing more and for worse seats.

breaking_news.headline: This mindset shift can help you get better at using up your leftovers
breaking_news.summary: Don't let your leftovers go to waste. Cookbook authors share clever storage techniques — like an "Eat Me First" box in your fridge — and cooking tricks to help you make the most of your food scraps.

breaking_news.headline: Red, white and glowing blue: Trump's push for new reactors reaches the finish line
breaking_news.summary: A program initiated by the Trump administration has allowed small companies to rush their testing of several new nuclear reactor designs. Some worry that safety is being compromised.

breaking_news.headline: Supreme Court cements Trump's power over agencies long considered independent
breaking_news.summary: In a 6-3 decision, the Supreme Court struck down a 91-year-old precedent that has prevented presidents from removing members of independent agencies meant to be a check on his power.

breaking_news.headline: Computer scientist on why he believes mass layoffs due to AI is a 'convenient excuse'
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Princeton computer scientist Sayash Kapoor about his assertions that AI won't lead to mass layoffs.

breaking_news.headline: Tricks to help you spend less money at restaurants
breaking_news.summary: Personal finance and nutrition experts share simple strategies that make it possible to eat out without spending a fortune. One tip? You might have to let go of your fast food delivery habit.

breaking_news.headline: Meta considered buying Kalshi before developing its own prediction market app
breaking_news.summary: Mark Zuckerberg met with Kalshi's CEO last year about a potential deal, but talks did not move forward. Now Meta is making its own prediction market app.

breaking_news.headline: Alleged Scattered Spider hacker arrested in Finland
breaking_news.summary: The 19-year-old dual American-Estonian national has been extradited to the US, where he is facing federal charges.

breaking_news.headline: Did this AI anti-drug video make drugs look appealing?
breaking_news.summary: Hong Kong’s Correctional Services Department removed an AI-generated K-pop video, after facing backlash that it made substances look too appealing.

breaking_news.headline: Gaza patients face agonising delays for medical evacuation
breaking_news.summary: An estimated 300 Palestinians referred for treatment abroad have died since the ceasefire began, according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry.

breaking_news.headline: Aunt of Venezuelan boy pulled from rubble tells BBC she will give him 'mother's warmth'
breaking_news.summary: Kleiber Moran, 2, was rescued on Wednesday, six days after last week's deadly earthquakes.

breaking_news.headline: China says pilot crashed small plane into skyscraper for 'personal reasons'
breaking_news.summary: The 66-year-old, who died in the crash, had anxiety and referenced "ending his life" in his diary.

breaking_news.headline: Canadian boy, 11, dies of rabies after waking to bat on his face
breaking_news.summary: Rabies infections are rare in Canada. There have been 28 human deaths due to rabies in the country since 1924.

breaking_news.headline: People smuggler convicted in France found by BBC living in UK and seeking asylum
breaking_news.summary: Once described as "the godfather" of French migrant camps, he has been working in a Leicestershire village.

breaking_news.headline: 'Most massive' Russian attack on Kyiv kills at least 18
breaking_news.summary: Kyiv's mayor declares a day of mourning after the major drone and missile attack on the Ukrainian capital.

breaking_news.headline: Don't expect connected car apps to save your stolen car, experts say
breaking_news.summary: Kia told the BBC UK law prevented its location tracking function being used to live track vehicles.

breaking_news.headline: Bibles, Home Alone and perfume: Six takeaways from Trump's 2025 finances
breaking_news.summary: Official documents show the US president made billions of dollars as he returned to the White House.

breaking_news.headline: Why the expected fight over the North American trade deal never kicked off
breaking_news.summary: The US has confirmed it will not extend the agreement for another 16 years, but stopped short of more dramatic action.

breaking_news.headline: Google must pay €4.1bn fine for using Android to 'block' rivals
breaking_news.summary: A Google spokesperson said the judgement "fails to recognise" the firm's "significant investment to ensure Android remains open."
